verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a SaaS networking product with an admin console, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no assistant inside Tailscale that users can delegate tasks to. The Tailscale skill serves external coding agents, Aperture is an LLM gateway, and the Aperture CLI runs third-party coding agents through that gateway; these are adjacent features, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
